Frequently asked questions

What does the $99/month cover?

Everything: hosting, SSL, your custom domain, ongoing local and AI-search optimization, unlimited small content edits, lead-capture forms, and a monthly check-in. It's a service, not a one-time file — we keep the site working and competitive month after month.

Is there a long-term contract?

No. Managed Growth is month-to-month. Cancel any time by email; billing stops and the site goes offline at the end of your paid period. Your domain stays yours.

How long does it take to launch?

7 days from when you start your plan and send us your business info. We build it, you review and approve, we go live.

Who makes changes after launch?

We do. Email us "add a service" or "swap this photo" and we make the change — included in your plan, typically within two business days.

What about my domain?

If you have one, we point it at your new site. If you don't, we register one in your name (about $12/year). Either way, the domain is yours.

Do you guarantee leads?

No. We build and maintain the lead-capture machinery — a fast, optimized site with click-to-call and forms. Actual lead volume depends on your market, competition, and Google, which take time.

What if I'd rather own it outright?

Choose the Ownership plan: $497 one-time. We build the site and export it to your own hosting, with a month of transition support. After that there's no ongoing service — hosting, updates, and SEO are yours to manage.

What happens if I cancel Managed Growth later?

Billing stops and the site comes offline at the end of the period you've paid for. If you want to keep it, a one-time static export to your own host is available at Ownership pricing.
